availability_audit: Chronology: every source map precedes Mt Chimney in book play order. Togepi Route102 land gate14 -> friendship Togetic -> Shiny Stone Togekiss gate24. Mawile GraniteCave_B1F land gate20; Mawilite stone-window=20 with the post-Brawly Mega Ring, base-window=20. Marill Petalburg City old_rod gate14 -> Azumarill level evo gate20. Chinchou Seaspray_Cave land gate14 -> Lanturn level evo gate30. Abra GraniteCave_1F gate20 -> Kadabra -> Alakazam Linking Cord gate20. Wooper Seaspray_Cave land gate14 -> Quagsire level evo gate20. No legendaries, mythicals, Ultra Beasts or Paradox species; single Mega slot. Ordinary held items from the free Center held-item catalogue.
plan: Attempt 1 lost 6-2 because two frail members (Starmie, Gallade) were fed into a board with two live attackers and because Mega Gyarados is 2x weak to Mightyena's Play Rough. Rebuild around Poison immunity and Dark resistance: Mega Mawile is immune to Gunk Shot and Cross Poison, resists Sucker Punch and Crunch, and Huge Power Play Rough answers Mightyena, Shiftry and Crobat. Togekiss leads with Follow Me and Tailwind so the slow Mawile gets a safe Mega turn. Lanturn is the bulky Fire/Flying answer with Thunderbolt for Crobat. Alakazam swaps Life Orb for Focus Sash so Sucker Punch cannot remove it for free. Quagsire's Unaware ignores Arbok's Coil and its Ground damage answers Ninetales and Mega Camerupt.
